_comment: Community event albums. Newest first or any order: the site sorts by date.
1. Grade/resize the photos with PhotoCraft into assets/images/events/<id>/ as
2. Copy the example below into "events", fill it in, save.
id: folder name, e.g. 2025-sinhala-new-year (letters, numbers, dashes)
date: YYYY-MM-DD (the album shows month + year in the reader's language)
title / text: one name and one or two sentences in de, en, si
cover: the photo name used on the album card
photos: photo names in the order they should appear
Only add photos the people in them are OK with (see CLAUDE.md).
